intent_summary: Callers can apply a different explicit action policy to existing assessments and cases without recomputing numerical analysis.

criteria.criterion: Default policy leaves action and notification eligibility disabled.
criteria.notes: Default flags disable both eligibility types, including after replay resets policy.

criteria.criterion: Explicit-rule and calibrated-departure eligibility are controlled independently.
criteria.notes: Explicit-only permission does not enable a calibrated departure; the matching calibrated choice does.

criteria.criterion: Notification eligibility can be allowed for a met criterion without action eligibility, while early candidates remain ineligible.
criteria.notes: Notification-only replay enables a met rule while keeping action disabled; permissive settings still cannot enable candidates.

criteria.criterion: Replaying policy preserves numerical evidence and stable case IDs, records changed case revisions, and leaves the original result unchanged.
criteria.notes: Assertions compare unchanged original serialization, methods, evidence references, stable IDs, and eligibility-dependent revision changes.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent re-inspected declared implementation references and criterion evidence in the current session after the outcome-title and deliverable-lane refactor.
Executed and inspected CLI examples, time preparation, policy replay, open-day monitoring, and MCP conversion evidence drilldown; .capabilities/reviews/deliverable-lanes/manual-checks.json.
